result.reason: The redline reaches at least the fallback position and partially achieves the preferred position: it expressly covers contractors and permits assignment to an assuming successor in a genuine M&A transaction without consent. The notwithstanding language adequately overrides the conflicting non-assignment provisions while preserving Authorized Location and additional-fee restrictions. It does not add the preferred perpetual/irrevocable treatment for paid-up licences or the uncured-material-breach termination standard for subscriptions, so it does not achieve the full preferred position, but those protections are not required by the stated fallback.
